title: Message
description: A durable message envelope — the communication primitive of HumanGateway. Carries ID, sender, recipients, conversation, workflow/task references, payload, artifact references, correlation tokens, and timestamps (PROTO-FR-03). Artifacts are referenced by ID + hash, never embedded (PROTO-FR-04).

id.description: Durable message ID (SYNC-FR-01). Never reused; used by receivers for idempotent deduplication.

sender.description: The participant that created the message.

recipients.description: Intended recipients. Delivery state is tracked per recipient in the Delivery entity.

conversationId.description: Conversation this message belongs to. Conversation membership governs authorisation (SP-04, AUTH-FR-03).

replyToMessageId.description: Message ID this message replies to, if any.

workflowRef.description: Opaque consumer workflow/run identifier (e.g. a FlowForge workflow execution). Not interpreted by HumanGateway.

humanTaskId.description: ID of the HumanTask this message is the request or response for, if any.

data.description: Optional structured data for agent/system messages.

artifactRefs.description: References to attached artifacts (ID + hash + rendering metadata). Artifact bytes are never embedded in the envelope (PROTO-FR-04).

correlationTokens.description: Consumer correlation tokens passed through unchanged (SP-09).

createdAt.description: When the sender created the message (durable, set once).

updatedAt.description: When the envelope last changed (e.g. delivery metadata updates).

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON encoding of the envelope, excluding the contentHash field itself (SYNC-FR-02). Verified by both sync peers.
